description: As a native Idahoan, Agriculture Education teacher and FFA Advisor for 35 years, Shawn Dygert has also sat on the Owyhee County Republican Central Committee as a Chairman for 10 years. He understands Idaho and what it takes to maintain conservative values for the people of District 23B.
